q: Bring Grimbooze Thunderbrew a bundle of Charred Oak.
Bring 8 Torn Murloc Fins to Guard Thomas at the east Elwynn bridge.
Kill 6 Mountain Buzzards and return to Daryl the Youngling in the Farstrider Lodge within 15 minutes.
Explore Frostmane Hold, and kill 5 Frostmane Headhunters for Senir Whitebeard in Kharanos.
Report to High Executor Hadrec at the Sepulcher.
Bring 10 Singing Blue Crystals to Crank Fizzlebub in Booty Bay.
Bring Furlbrow's Deed to Farmer Furlbrow.
Speak with Innkeeper Farley at the Lion's Pride Inn.
Get 10 Scorpid Worker Tails for Gornek in the Den.
Bring a sign of Kron's fate to Misha Tor'kren at the farmstead northwest of Razor Hill.
Collect 6 Azure Feathers and 6 Bronze Feathers, and bring them to Eyahn Eagletalon in Thunder Bluff.
Bring a Moonsteel Broadsword to Jarl in Dustwallow Marsh.
Kill 8 Razormane Geomancers, 8 Razormane Defenders, and Kreenig Snarlsnout.
Collect 7 Small Spider Legs for Zarrin in Dolanaar.
Acquire 6 Bloodfeather Belts and bring them to Sentinel Arynia Cloudsbreak in the Oracle Glade.
Nalpak in the Wailing Caverns wants 20 Deviate Hides.
Bring the Gems of Cobrahn, Anacondra, Pythas and Serpentis to Nara Wildmane in Thunder Bluff.
Bring Frostmaw's Mane to Melor Stonehoof in Thunder Bluff.
Bring Karnitol's Satchel to Roetten Stonehammer in Ironforge.
Use Morbent's Bane on Morbent Fel, kill Morbent Fel, then return Morbent's Bane to Sven at his camp.
Bring ten Vulture Gizzards and two Snickerfang Jowls to Bloodmage Lynnore.
Bring ten Vulture Gizzards and two Snickerfang Jowls to Bloodmage Lynnore.
Priestess A'moora wants you to place Lady Sathrah's silvery spinnerets at the fountain inside the temple, and then return to her.
Retrieve the Rig Blueprints and Thermaplugg's Safe Combination from Gnomeregan and bring them to Nogg in Orgrimmar.
Venture to Gnomeregan and kill Mekgineer Thermaplugg. Return to High Tinker Mekkatorque when the task is complete.
Escort OOX-22/FE to the dock along the Forgotten Coast, then report to Oglethorpe Obnoticus in Booty Bay.
Bring Iverron's Antidote to Iverron before the time limit is up. Iverron can be found by the cave to the north.
Defeat Mok'Morokk and report the news to Draz'Zilb in Brackenwall Village.
In your journeys throughout the Blasted Lands, should you ever come across a Flawless Draenethyst Sphere, take the item back to Kum'isha the Collector.
Find and return a Flawless Draenethyst Sphere to Kum'isha the Collector.
Andrew Brownell wants you to kill Amnennar the Coldbringer and return his skull.
Archbishop Bendictus wants you to slay Amnennar the Coldbringer in Razorfen Downs.
Speak with Shandris Feathermoon in Feathermoon Stronghold.
Travel to Fire Plume Ridge, south of Marshal's Refuge.
Bring the Lost Thunderbrew Recipe to Ragnar Thunderbrew in Kharanos.
Bring the Lost Thunderbrew Recipe to Vivian Lagrave in Kargath.
Use the Eggscilloscope Prototype on an egg in the Rookery.
Travel to Blackrock Spire and find Bloodaxe Worg Pups. Use the cage to carry the ferocious little beasts. Bring back a Caged Worg Pup to Kibler.
Speak to Witch Doctor Mau'ari again in a moment to receive the lucky charm.
Travel to Blackrock Spire and find Goraluk Anvilcrack. Slay him and then use the Blood Stained Pike upon his corpse. After his soul has been siphoned, the pike will be Soul Stained.
Bring the Northshire Gift Voucher to Merissa Stilwell.
Bring the Coldridge Valley Gift Voucher to Yori Crackhelm.
Bring the Shadowglen Gift Voucher to Orenthil Whisperwind.
Bring the Valley of Trials Gift Voucher to Magga.
Bring the Camp Narache Gift Voucher to Vorn Skyseer.
Bring the Deathknell Gift Voucher to Claire Willower in Deathknell.
Travel to Blackrock Spire and slay Warchief Rend Blackhand. Take his head and return to Orgrimmar.
Travel to Blackrock Spire and destroy General Drakkisath. Return to Marshal Maxwell when the job is done.
Deliver the Crystal of Zin-Malor to Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm in Darnassus.
Bring 8 Ghost-o-plasms and the Crate of Ghost Magnets to Hornizz Brimbuzzle in Desolace.
Return to Thunder Bluff and show Turak Runetotem the Pendant of the Sea Lion.
Return to Darnassus and show Mathrengyl Bearwalker the Pendant of the Sea Lion.
When Smokey Sings, I Get Violent

Travel to Plaguewood, northwest of Light's Hope. Destroy 8 Scourge Structures by using Smokey's Special Compound at the Mark of Detonation planted inside each building. Smokey has had the Ziggurats and Slaughterhouses marked.
Collect the missing pages from The Green Hills of Stranglethorn manuscript. Once all four chapters are complete, return them to Barnil.
Deep within the Slag Pit of the Cauldron, in the Searing Gorge, you will find the traitorous Dark Iron dwarf named Overseer Maltorius.
Paragons of Power: The Vindicator's Armguards
Bring Jin'rokh the Breaker a Primal Hakkari Armsplint. You must also have a reputation equal to or greater than Friendly with the Zandalar Tribe.
Paragons of Power: The Demoniac's Wraps
Bring Al'tabim the All-Seeing a Primal Hakkari Stanchion. You must also have a reputation equal to or greater than Friendly with the Zandalar Tribe.
Bring the Tooth of Morphaz to Ogtinc in Azshara. Ogtinc resides atop the cliffs northeast the Ruins of Eldarath.
Do a dance emote at Innkeeper Saelienne, and in exchange you'll receive Darnassus Marzipan!
Security Chief Bilgewhizzle of Steamwheedle Port in Tanaris wants you to kill 10 Southsea Pirates, 10 Southsea Freebooters, 10 Southsea Dock Workers and 10 Southsea Swashbucklers.

Report for duty at the Ironforge Brigade post near Hive'Zora. Prepare your Unsigned Field Duty Papers and obtain Signed Field Duty Papers from Captain Blackanvil and return to Windcaller Kaldon at Cenarion Hold in Silithus.

Report to Krug Skullsplit at the Orgrimmar Legion post in front of Hive'Regal. Prepare your Unsigned Field Duty Papers, obtain Signed Field Duty Papers and bring them to Windcaller Kaldon in Cenarion Hold.
Grazle wants you to prove yourself by killing 6 Deadwood Warriors, 6 Deadwood Pathfinders, and 6 Deadwood Gardeners. Return to him in southern Felwood near the Emerald Sanctuary when you are done.

Bring the Skin of the Great Sandworm, 2 Idols of Rebirth, 5 Gold Scarabs and 5 Clay Scarabs to Kandrostrasz inside Ahn'Qiraj. You must also attain Friendly reputation with the Brood of Nozdormu to complete this quest.
Bring Vek'lor's Diadem, 2 Idols of the War, 5 Gold Scarabs and 5 Clay Scarabs to Andorgos in Ahn'Qiraj. You must also attain Friendly reputation with the Brood of Nozdormu to complete this quest.

Bring 1 Qiraji Magisterial Ring, 2 Alabaster Idols, 5 Bronze Scarabs and 5 Ivory Scarabs to Windcaller Yessendra in Silithus. You must also attain Honored reputation with Cenarion Circle to complete this quest.
Deliver the Head of Ossirian the Unscarred to Commander Mar'alith at Cenarion Hold in Silithus.
Take the Colossus of Ashi's Husk to Oglethorpe Obnoticus in Booty Bay.
Take the Colossus of Regal's Husk to Overseer Oilfist in Searing Gorge.
Take the Colossus of Zora's Husk to Lord Maxwell Tyrosus at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands.
Return to Deliana in Ironforge with a set of Shadowcraft Boots, Shadowcraft Pants and Shadowcraft Spaulders.
Return to Mokvar in Orgimmar with a set of Shadowcraft Boots, Shadowcraft Pants and Shadowcraft Spaulders.
Give Deliana your Devout Crown and Devout Robe.
Give Mokvar your Devout Crown and Devout Robe.
Retrieve a Putrid Vine from the guardian at the bottom of the Sunken Temple and return to Torwa Pathfinder.
Return to Mux Manascrambler in Gadgetzan with 1 Delicate Arcanite Converter, 4 Greater Eternal Essence, 10 Stonescale Oil, 25 Volcanic Ash and 40 gold.
Return to Bodley inside Blackrock Mountain and give him the Brazier of Beckoning.

Korfax at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make a Dreadnaught Breastplate if you bring him the following items: 1 Desecrated Breastplate, 25 Wartorn Plate Scraps, 4 Arcanite Bars and 2 Nexus Crystals.

Huntsman Leopold at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make Cryptstalker Boots if you bring him the following: 1 Desecrated Boots, 12 Wartorn Chain Scraps, 1 Arcanite Bar and 3 Nexus Crystals.

Rimblat Earthshatter at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make an Earthshatter Tunic if you bring him the following: 1 Desecrated Tunic, 25 Wartorn Chain Scraps, 4 Arcanite Bars and 3 Cured Rugged Hides.

Rayne at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make a Dreamwalker Tunic if you bring her the following: 1 Desecrated Tunic, 25 Wartorn Leather Scraps, 6 Cured Rugged Hides and 2 Nexus Crystals.

Father Inigo Montoy at Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands will make a Robe of Faith if you bring him the following: 1 Desecrated Robe, 25 Wartorn Cloth Scraps, 4 Mooncloth and 2 Nexus Crystals.

Anachronos at the Caverns of Time in Tanaris wants you to take Atiesh, Greatstaff of the Guardian to Stratholme and use it on Consecrated Earth. Defeat the entity that is exorcised from the staff and return to him.

For 20 Insignias of the Dawn and 20 Insignias of the Crusade you may choose an item from the Argent Dawn's treasure cache.
Superior Armaments of Battle - Revered Amongst the Dawn
For 7 Insignias of the Dawn and 7 Insignias of the Crusade you may choose an item from the Argent Dawn's treasure cache.
Superior Armaments of Battle - Exalted Amongst the Dawn
For 6 Insignias of the Dawn and 6 Insignias of the Crusade you may choose an item from the Argent Dawn's treasure cache.
